newsitem.title: USA: Intl Verifact urged to consider deal.
newsitem.headline: Intl Verifact urged to consider deal.

text.p: American Banknote Corp, an investor in International Verifact Inc, said it wants to meet with George Whitton, chairman and CEO of International, to explore the opportunity for a "strategic transaction" between the two companies that could enhance shareholder value.
It said Friday it urged International Verifact to take a "fresh look" at its business strategies.

"I.V.I. Management and its Board of Directors should immediately undertake an objective evaluation of business strategies so as to maximize shareholder value," American Banknote wrote in a letter to International Verifact.

In the letter dated Nov 21, Morris Weissman, chairman and CEO of American Banknote, said International's performance over the past 10 months has been "extremely disappointing" and does not seem to be improving at any accelerated rate.
American Banknote holds a 6.36 percent stake in the Toronto-based company or 447,500 common shares.
International Verifact makes payment systems for retailers, banks and governments. American Banknote, a New York-based company, is a check printing company.
